Precious metals prices fluctuate amid dollar and rate hike concerns

The prices of gold and silver have been affected by the recent breach of key support levels, with both metals experiencing a negative trend. The US Federal Reserve's decision to ease interest rates has also impacted the market. Investors are advised to monitor the situation closely.
